S: the beach town on the Fourth of July
Clam meat or calamari strips soaked in buttermilk, dredged in fine cornmeal and flour, fried at 185C for 90 seconds, tartare and lemon.
A smoked trout dip: hot-smoked trout flaked into cream cheese, sour cream, lemon, dill and horseradish, served in a little bucket with crackers.
Shark fin tortilla chips with salsa

Flour tortillas cut into fin shapes, baked crisp with lime salt, served with a charred tomato, jalapeno and coriander salsa and guacamole. Cut 6 flour tortillas into tall triangles with a curved back like a fin. Brush with oil, sprinkle with salt and lime zest and bake at 180C for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp. Char 4 tomatoes and a jalapeno in a dry pan, chop with half a red onion, a handful of coriander and lime juice. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Stand the fins up in the guacamole.
M: Cooked lobster chopped, folded with a little mayo, lemon, celery and chives, piled into butter-toasted rolls. Chips.

Clams steamed open, then simmered in a creamy bacon, potato and celery chowder with the clam juices, finished with parsley and oyster crackers. Steam 1kg clams in 125ml white wine in a covered pot for 4 minutes until open, then pick the meat and strain the liquid. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp, add a diced onion and 2 celery sticks and soften. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then the clam liquid, 500ml milk and 500g diced potato. Simmer 15 minutes until tender. Add 150ml cream and the clams, warm through and finish with parsley and oyster crackers.
W: you're gonna need a bigger bowl
Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a shark fin cut from a dark chocolate disc.
K: Ice cold lager poured over lime, hot sauce, Worcestershire and tomato juice in a chilli salt rimmed glass, with a lime wedge on top. Mix 2 tsp chilli flakes with 2 tbsp salt on a plate. Rub the rims of four pint glasses with lime and dip in the salt. Fill with ice. Add to each glass the juice of half a lime, 3 dashes hot sauce, a dash of Worcestershire and 60ml tomato juice. Top each with a 375ml can of cold lager, stir once and crush the can.

s.note: the beach town on the Fourth of July
s.how: Cut 500g calamari into strips and soak in 200ml buttermilk for 20 minutes. Dredge in 100g cornmeal mixed with 50g flour and fry at 185C for 90 seconds. Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.
Flake 200g hot-smoked trout into 150g cream cheese and 100g sour cream with lemon juice, chopped dill and a little horseradish. Spoon into a small bucket and serve with crackers.

m.how: Chop 400g cooked lobster meat and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a finely diced celery stick and chives. Butter and toast 4 split hot dog buns and fill. Fry 800g potato chips twice and serve alongside.
